newsitem.title: PERU: Lima shares ease before growth figure.
newsitem.headline: Lima shares ease before growth figure.

text.p: Peruvian stocks eased 0.37 percent on Monday in lower-than-average volume as investors stayed on the sidelines to await official growth figures due later in the week, traders said.

"There was not much movement in the market, even though an encouraging figure for gross domestic product is expected," said Pablo Navarro of Fortuna, "It still has to be confirmed to see which sectors have grown strongly."
Traders expected activity to remain slow until the GDP figure for January is announced Tuesday or Wednesday, although they said some stocks could rise on speculation.
The .IGRA general share index slipped 0.37 percent to 1,614.07, and the blue chip selective index .ISEL fell 0.31 percent to 2,311.25.
Turnover was 21.1 million soles ($8.0 million), and 23 stocks fell, 38 closed steady, and 24 rose.
Telefonica del Peru "B" lost 1.36 percent, Banco de Credito slipped 0.92 percent, and Minera Buenaventura fell 0.91 percent.
Mining stocks Morococha and Minsur rose in low volume, by 2.11 percent and 0.11 percent respectively
Telefonica del Peru was the most traded stock, accounting for 18.26 percent of total volume.
